chapter: Building the band: Dave Duncan, Denver and Rene Hall
title: Leaving the electric job and the Schoonover tour of the northwest
summary: Back at the Tulsa Club story, Fields quits electric work, adds players, and signs with agent H.E. Schoonover for a northwest tour.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: I worked extensively with Roy and your name was always mentioned.
What was the last place we were saying?
You were playing at the Tulsa Club--
The coming out party for Skelly?
Yeah, Joanne Skelly. Her going out party. We were kind of on our way---as I said I had given up my job.

Yeah. We had Rene Hall and we began to add a piece or two and I got a young man out of Wichita, Kansas, Delma Willis and Bob Graham on tenor and a fellow came, H.E. Schoonover, an agent, and he came in and says I'd like to carry you on a tour of the northwest and we talked to the guys and they said yeah, yeah, yeah. And so we told him to go ahead and he told us to give him a four or five day start and I signed an agreement with him and we went on and made the trip.
